text:
Senator Bill Cassidy issues storm warning and honors Tim Murphy in recent posts
U.S. Senator Bill Cassidy, M.D., used his social media account in recent days to address severe weather warnings and pay tribute to a late colleague.
On July 21, 2026, Cassidy posted: "Tropical storm conditions are expected as Bertha gets closer to southeast Louisiana. It doesn't take a hurricane for isolated flooding and storm surge to impact low-lying communities. Listen closely to your local weather channel and authorities!"
Earlier, on July 20, 2026, he shared a message commemorating Tim Murphy: "Tim Murphy was the most compassionate advocate for working Americans, for those impacted by life stress, and for those who needed mental health resources. Rest in peace."
Senator Cassidy also included a tweet on July 19, 2026, without additional commentary or context: https://t.co/0EbkNUtDOd
Senator Cassidy serves on the Senate Finance, Energy and Natural Resources, and Veterans Affairs Committees, according to his official website. He co-founded the Greater Baton Rouge Community Clinic to provide free health and dental care to the working uninsured and continues to advance initiatives focused on reducing healthcare costs and reforming mental health systems. Cassidy holds undergraduate and medical degrees from Louisiana State University. He is married to a retired breast cancer surgeon; together they have raised three children.
